# Wikipedia fixtures

Hand-written HTML that reproduces the *structure* of the rendered results grid of a
league season article (the `sports results` module's table). The values are made up
and no text is copied from Wikipedia.

`cup.html` reproduces the structure of a cup season article's match boxes: the "Football box
collapsible" template (`table.tmpl-football-box-collapsible`) and the "Football box" template
(`div.footballbox`), with every score form the reader handles. Clubs, dates and scores are made up.
